description:
Subject: Deployment details for **myProgram_01** (v1.2.3)

The new Python‑based data processing script, **process_logs.py**, has been added to the central logging scope (`central.logging`). Its purpose is to aggregate daily logs, and it carries the description “A Python based data processing script that aggregates logs daily.” The program is authored by **Jane Doe** and is enabled for auto‑start on system boot (the disabled flag is set to false). The required environment variables have been defined as follows: `LOG_LEVEL` set to **INFO**, `OUTPUT_DIR` set to **/var/data/processed**, and `MAX_THREADS` set to **4**. This configuration aligns with the program ID **myProgram_01** and uses Python as its programming language.
